regex.description: config:recommended ignores **/tests/**, which would hide tests/CMakeLists.txt from the GEOS manager below. The custom managers only read the files that they name.

customManagers.description: gerbv Git tag built from source in CI (GERBV_GIT_TAG)

GEOS release tag built from source in CI (&geos_version in .github/workflows/ci.yml) and required by the integration tests (PCB2GCODE_INTEGRATION_GEOS_VERSION in tests/CMakeLists.txt). The two versions must be the same, and these matchStrings must match both lines. When you change any of the three, adjust the other two.
